# MCP tools: Steps and actions

<!-- Generated by `sidekick.mcp.export_tool_reference` from `contracts/mcp-tools.generated.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

[MCP tool reference](index.md) | 8 model-visible tools. The tools of this area that only the MCP App rooms call are on the [app-only page](app-only.md).

## `list_task_steps`

List bounded ordered Steps for one owned Task, each with its action_count; next_cursor continues.

Access: read

Scopes: requires `tasks:read`.

Returns: `ListedStepPageOutput` with `items` (array of ListedStepRecord), `next_cursor` (string or null).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `task_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `cursor` | string | no | up to 2048 characters; may be null |
| `limit` | integer | no | default `100`; 1 to 100 |

## `create_task_step`

Create an ordered Step under one owned Task with a retry-safe key.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `tasks:read`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `StepOutput` with `step` (StepRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `task_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `title` | string | yes | 1 to 200 characters |
| `due_at` | date-time | no | ISO 8601 date and time; may be null |

## `update_task_step`

Update a Step with optimistic version checking.

Access: write

Scopes: requires `tasks:read`, `tasks:write`.

Returns: `StepOutput` with `step` (StepRecord).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `changes` | object | yes | - |
| `changes.attention_requested` | boolean | no | may be null |
| `changes.due_at` | date-time | no | ISO 8601 date and time; may be null |
| `changes.instruction` | string | no | up to 2000 characters; may be null |
| `changes.status` | string | no | one of `todo`, `in_progress`, `blocked`, `completed`; may be null |
| `changes.title` | string | no | 1 to 200 characters; may be null |
| `idempotency_key` | string | yes | 8 to 128 characters |
| `step_id` | uuid | yes | - |
| `version` | integer | yes | at least 1 |

A nested field is listed under its parent as `parent.field`; `parent[].field` is a field of each item in the list. Required means required inside its parent.
